builds.name: Noxious Trap ceiling
builds.summary: One mushroom deals 450+.5 AP over 4s. Persistent magic damage refreshes burns; no assumption that overlapping mushrooms stack their kit poison independently.
builds.goal: One mushroom deals 450+.5 AP over 4s. Persistent magic damage refreshes burns; no assumption that overlapping mushrooms stack their kit poison independently.
builds.hypothesis:
Teemo tosses a mushroom trap that detonates when stepped on. The traps Slow by [30 / 40 / 50]% and deal [200 / 325 / 450 + (0.5) × AP] magic damage over [4] seconds. Enemies are revealed for the same duration.

Traps last [5] minutes and are stealthed. A mushroom tossed onto another mushroom bounces before landing at its position. This Ability has [3 / 4 / 5] charges (@AmmoRechargeTime@ second refresh).
Deathcap multiplies AP; Void Staff and Shadowflame reduce effective MR on magic packets, with Shadowflame low-health amplification tested. Zhonya/Banshee are high AP stat slots; Riftmaker is fully ramped before scoring. Mana variants use earned Seraph for mana-derived AP, read live; burn variants use Liandry ramp and Blackfire one-target AP buff, with proc damage separate. First Strike adds a separately measured initiation bonus; Absolute Focus supplies adaptive stat only above its health threshold; Gathering Storm is fixed to 30min. Cash Back/Biscuit/Cosmic are economy/sustain/utility, not assumed direct damage multipliers.

Trigger exactly one mushroom and observe 4s poison plus finite burn tail; separate proc damage. Report observed damage only while the target survives; any theoretical full-window overkill is a separate raw-potential metric, not damage actually dealt.

Rabadon's Deathcap, Void Staff, Shadowflame, Riftmaker, Liandry's Torment, Blackfire Torch. Required setup damage is excluded from scored ability. Defensive or attack-speed replacements may win real fights despite a lower isolated packet.
Confidence: speculative. This is a finite-condition ceiling candidate, not a solver-certified global maximum or a recommended match build.

builds.name: Toxic Shot: one hit and complete poison
builds.summary: Investigate high one Toxic Shot impact and four-second poison output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.goal: Investigate high one Toxic Shot impact and four-second poison output with a finite, reproducible setup; compare controlled item swaps instead of claiming a global maximum.
builds.hypothesis: Rank-5 E impact is 65 + 0.3 AP + 0.05 bonus AD magic, followed by four times (30 + 0.1 AP + 0.025 bonus AD). One complete application nominally totals 185 + 0.7 AP + 0.15 bonus AD, excluding the physical attack. Bonus AD is a real but smaller route in this source snapshot.

ceiling.targetName: one Toxic Shot impact and four-second poison

No dragons, elixirs or allied stat buffs. Record actual AD/AP, HP and resist modifiers. Gathering Storm at minute 30 if selected; no free permanent stacks. Stop observed damage scoring on death, cap observed healing at missing HP, and report raw output separately. Seraph legally transformed. One attack applies E to one champion; no later attack refreshes poison during the four-second observation. No Q, mushroom, monster modifier or allied damage. Record actual bonus AD/AP and target health at each tick.
